verses.gurmukhi: ਆਂਧਰੋ ਕਉ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਟੇਕ ਬਹਰੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aa(n)dharo kau sabadh surat kar char Tek baharai charan kar dhirasaT sabadh hai ||

en.bdb: A blind person has support of the words, ability to hear, hands and feet. A deaf has much reliance on his hands feet, vision of the eyes and the words that he speaks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਟੇਕ ਚਰ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੂਲੇ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਪਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: goo(n)gai Tek char kar dhirasaT sabadh surat liv loole Tek dhirasaT sabadh srut padh hai ||

en.bdb: A dumb has support of ears for listening, feet, hands vision of the eyes. A handless person relies much on eyes speech, hearing and feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਗੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ  ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਅਛਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: paagure kau Tek dhirasaT sabadh surat kar  Tek ek ek a(n)g heen dheenataa achhadh hai ||

en.bdb: One who is lame or without legs rely on sight of his eyes speech, ability to hear, and use of his hands. Despite capacitated of one limb or faculty, the dependence on others remain hidden.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਪੰਗ ਲੁੰਜ ਦੁਖ ਪੁੰਜ ਮਮ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਰਬੀਨ ਸਦ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)dh gu(n)g su(n)n pa(n)g lu(n)j dhukh pu(n)j mam a(n)tar ke a(n)tarajaamee parabeen sadh hai ||314||

en.bdb: But I am blind, dumb, deaf, maimed of hand and feet a mass of suffering. 0 my True Lord! You are the wisest and completely informed of all my innate pains. 0 My Lord, please be merciful and remove all my pains. (314)
